name: @app/document-annotation-ui
//: Dependency-only workspace member: it exists only when document-annotation-ui is selected, and carries the PDF viewer pins apps/web imports. The published capability package imports neither, so they are not its dependencies. The app links hoisted, so apps/web resolves them from the root node_modules. pdf.js refuses a worker of another version, so bump `pdfjs-dist` together with `apps/web/public/pdf.worker.min.mjs` (see INSTALL.md).
